title.zh: 授予Tertuliano G. Portes在宿务省皮纳蒙加汉市镇电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Tertuliano G. Portes a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Pinamungahan, Province of Cebu
title.orig: An Act Granting Tertuliano G. Portes a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Pinamungahan, Province of Cebu
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Tertuliano G. Portes để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại thị xã Pinamungahan, tỉnh Cebu
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Tertuliano G. Portes เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Pinamungahan, จังหวัด Cebu
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Tertuliano G. Portes untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Pinamungahan, Provinsi Cebu
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Tertuliano G. Portes untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Perbandaran Pinamungahan, Wilayah Cebu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1348_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to Tertuliano G. Portes for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the Municipality of Pinamungahan, Province of Cebu.

In the event that the grantee shall purchase and secure from the National Power Corporation electric heat and power, the National Power Corporation is hereby authorized to negotiate and transact for the benefit and in behalf of the public consumers with reference to rates.

It is expressly provided that, in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the system and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender his franchise and will turn over to the Government all serviceable equipment therein, at cost, less reasonable depreciation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1955.
